data.subject: Public-record research for Orchard Capital
data.body:
Hi Orchard Capital team,

Orchard Capital’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in FIP, NODK, and IDR.

On September 28, 2026, FIP entered into a material definitive agreement, reported in an 8-K Item 1.01. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1899883/000114036126037763/ef20082849_8k.htm)

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research service based on public records, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot?

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Andrew
